name: Amalfi Drive - Positano
description: A point-to-point run on the Strada Statale 163 Amalfitana, the corniche cut into the cliffs above the Gulf of Salerno in the 1850s and still one of the great drives in Europe. Not quite six kilometres of blind rock tunnels, unguarded drops and villages stacked on the rock, starting from Positano.
author: EttieApple
